sloka: ततस्तमभिदुद्राव राक्षसेन्द्रमकम्पनम् ।पुरा हि नमुचिं सङ्ख्ये वज्रेणेव पुरन्दरः ।। ६.५६.१७ ।।।।
transliteration: tatastamabhidudrāva rākṣasendramakampanam ।purā hi namuciṁ saṅkhye vajreṇeva purandaraḥ ।। 6.56.17 ।।।।

translations.english: Then he went to Akampana and tormented him just as Indra did with his thunderbolt to Namuchi.
